neighbours.label: The noun that closes a pointer to the present text or the point under discussion: 'this⟦ article⟧', 'this⟦ topic⟧', 'this⟦ subject⟧', 'this⟦ claim⟧', 'this blog⟦ post⟧', and 'in⟦ place⟧' after a framework has been set up. The same nouns as ordinary objects (an article cut from a paper, a fence post) stay quiet.
fire: A complete history of the debate would take us far beyond this article, so I give only the outline.
Readers who want to dig deeper into this topic will find a reading list at the end.
For more on this subject, consult the handbook published by the society.
There is surprisingly little hard evidence behind this claim, as we shall see.
With the main definitions now in place, we can move on to the first example.
I have written about this topic before, and my view has not changed.
Nothing in this article should be taken as legal advice.
Several historians have written at length on this subject in recent years.
quiet: He folded the newspaper article and slipped it into his coat pocket.
The teacher wrote a list of topics on the board and left the room.
She studied three subjects at school and liked chemistry the most.
The insurance company paid out the claim within a week.
They found a quiet place by the river and set up the tent.
I have painted this fence before, and it has not lasted.
Nothing in this drawer should be thrown away without asking.
Several farmers have planted wheat on this land in recent years.

notes: Card: ' claim' x4, ' article' x2, ' topic' x2, ' suggesting' x2, ' discussion' x2, ' place' x1. Probes: 'this subject' 0.51, 'in place' 0.49, 'this article' 0.48, 'this topic' 0.48, 'this claim' 0.31-0.43, 'in hand' 0.30, 'this chapter' 0.24, 'this section' 0.21; weaker for 'this essay' 0.16, 'this issue' 0.11; 'the article' (newspaper) 0.03, 'the essay' 0.05, 'this house … this car' 0.03, fence 'post' 0.02. Moderate activations throughout, so the median may sit close to the 0.20 bar. The + pole peaks on sentence boundaries in descriptive reports (',' '.' ' There'), which does not look like the other side of this distinction.
